04 / A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before
you order.

A few good questions.
A little more clarity.

Ask us directly
How much is the 11 kg cylinder?

The listed price is Rs 5,000 per 11 kg cylinder. Confirm with the agency whether this is a filled-cylinder, refill or exchange price, and whether a deposit or delivery charge applies.

Can I request home delivery?

Yes, you can request it. Include your address in the order form or use the area enquiry above. The agency must confirm service for your location, the timing and the delivery charge.

Can I collect from the agency?

Choose “Collect from agency” in the order form. Confirm availability, a collection time and the exact location in Sohan, Islamabad before visiting.

Does the website confirm my order?

No. It prepares a request for you to send through WhatsApp. Your order is only confirmed when the agency replies and agrees the details. This website does not collect payments.

Are a regulator and accessories included?

Ask the agency to confirm what the price includes and which regulator and accessories are compatible with the supplied cylinder. Accessories are not listed as included on this website.

What about other sizes or business orders?

Contact Minhaj directly about other sizes, multiple cylinders or your business requirements. Only the 11 kg cylinder has a listed price here. Other sizes, stock and prices need confirmation.
